gemini.title: Offshore Special Areas Of Conservation
gemini.abstract: Offshore Special Areas Of Conservation is an authoritative dataset published by Government of Ireland. It represents offshore special areas of conservation features using polygon geometry.
gemini.lineage: Published by the Government of Ireland as part of the national spatial data exchange. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
